How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali masharti kufuatana kwa vitendo means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

4. Practise this skill: practise Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali masharti kufuatana kwa vitendo in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali masharti kufuatana kwa vitendo from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali masharti kufuatana kwa vitendo: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali masharti kufuatana kwa vitendo?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali masharti kufuatana kwa vitendo means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali masharti kufuatana kwa vitendo means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali masharti kufuatana kwa vitendo from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
